name: Rage Fishing
detailed_description:
Rage Fishing is a fast-paced arcade fishing game where every fish is a challenge — and every mistake makes you angrier. Inspired by the crazy rhythm of WarioWare, you face microgames lasting a few seconds that require quick reflexes, absurd decisions and a little luck.

You control Mr. Wormy, an angry worm in search of his girlfriend, Miss Wormy, who was captured by a mysterious fish during a regular fishing trip. Now, you will dive into the depths of the lake, facing bizarre creatures, ridiculous challenges and completely absurd situations.

In addition to the various microgames in each round, you will also face the lake's bosses — unique fish that require timing, patience and a pinch of rage. Defeat each one to get closer to Wormy's whereabouts and prove that worms can fight too.

Rage Fishing mixes the chaos of microgames with a retro pixel art aesthetic, cartoonish sound and nonsense humor, creating a fast, intense and addictive experience — ideal for those who enjoy games with an arcade soul and a meme feel.

🎣 Game Highlights:

  • Fishing microgames lasting 5 to 10 seconds

  • Charismatic and furious protagonist: Mr. Earthworm

  • Lake bosses: unique and funny challenges

  • Slapstick humor, retro pixel art and fast-paced sound

  • Combo system, rage mode and fish collection

  • Comical narrative with eccentric characters

  • A free demo (coming soon) to test your sanity

Who said fishing is something to get calm?
